title: capabilities_json
description: As-designed capabilities of a ship class, stored as a JSON object in the capabilities_json column of data/ship_classes.csv (blank when no source gives a figure). One key per figure, each with {value, unit, reference_id, note}; a key is absent when no source gives it. Keys mirror schema/vocabularies.json (ship_capability_key). A sub-type row repeats only the figures that differ from its family row.

value.description: The figure as the source states it, including its qualifier (for example '27,000 long tons (standard)').

unit.description: Unit of the figure where the value is a bare number, otherwise blank or absent.

reference_id.description: The reference (data/references_meta.csv) that gives this figure.

note.description: Optional: sub-type, variant, or as-built versus as-designed remark.
